title: Cross-Functional Roadmap Pulse and Risk Synthesis for Monthly Exec Readout
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Assemble an executive-facing monthly packet that synthesizes initiative health (OKRs & risks), near-term roadmap commitments, and targeted decision asks for the upcoming leadership readout. Packet will highlight: 1) initiatives at risk with root-cause analysis (capacity, infra, external dependencies), 2) latency/cost trade-offs for serving runtime investments, 3) proposed priority shifts and rollback/mitigation plans, and 4) explicit asks for cross-org support (eng capacity, design review, legal/compliance gating). Goal: provide a concise 8-12 slide executive narrative and an appendix with metrics & links to artifacts so execs can approve resource decisions and escalation lanes during the monthly QBR.
